title: Gated stored-leaf birthday search on secp256k1, two 55-bit VA ranges, at 123.284771626089265

claims.statement: Gated grouped stored-leaf birthday search (proof.md) recovers x from uniform secp256k1 Q=[x]P w.p. >= 0.39 (Q=O gives x=0). Coordinator 0 halts with no output unless a 128-bit RNDR u < K_GATE = 132750380434599887615646194868176967292 (p_gate ~ 0.390118306); else Phase-0 X-mining (E_mine <= 2^123.8686 insns; no output if a pool has < 4 valid pairs), then q1 = 103,079,062,500 batches in G = 6656 groups on 2^66 generators, 2^41 relays, 2^82 homes (CAP_H = 1,313,229,200,424,960). lo_run >= 0.999696744104 (rounded down), (K_GATE/2^128) lo_run >= 0.39 (exact rationals, c21). E_total = 256 insns + p_gate E_run <= 2^123.284771626089265 units of 1000 AArch64 insns (E_run <= 2^124.642789 units, <= 57.8550 insns/leaf of S = 2^128.754203); memory <= 2^137.9998 B; pre <= 2^116.2682 units; no advice; every run <= 2^172.9174 units (c55); premise IM: blocking-port link transport, a stated machine premise (not Arm-architected); endpoint instructions are charged, the links' routing, aperture mapping and arbitration are part of the premise (proof.md premises, 5.1, 8).

experiments.purpose: Checks leaf, Phase-0 and routing kernels on the two-55-bit-VA-range machine (incl. VA-0 wraps), rendezvous replay vs in-place delivery, bulk Y ring forwarding, leaf kernels on ring-delivered frames, the same leaves in two chunks, gate, C132 bound and counts.
